run_RAFT_training: run the RAFT optical flow model training loop with configurable datasets and mixed precision
create_optimizer_with_scheduler: create an AdamW optimizer and OneCycleLR scheduler for a PyTorch model using training args
compute_sequence_loss: compute the weighted sequence loss and EPE metrics over multiple optical flow predictions
count_trainable_parameters: count the total number of trainable parameters in a PyTorch model
log_training_metrics: log training metrics and validation results to TensorBoard using the Logger class
